oneLine: Cremica Foods buys back stake and plans an IPO at a Rs 2,000 crore valuation.

sources.title: Cremica Foods buys back Kroll stake, plans IPO at ₹2,000 crore valuation

synopsis: Cremica Foods Industries has bought back a 35% stake from institutional investor Kroll in a secondary transaction, moving away from a previously planned private fundraise. Following the buyback, the Bector family and angel investors own the company, with the family holding about 90%. Chairman and managing director Akshay Bector stated that the company is preparing for an initial public offering scheduled for next financial year, which could value Cremica Foods between ₹1,500 crore and ₹2,000 crore. The transaction value of Kroll's exit was not disclosed. The company anticipates achieving sales of about ₹450 crore and an EBITDA of ₹65 to 70 crore in the ongoing fiscal year as it expands its branded foods business and overseas operations.
